primary_metric: total formation events of S0-S1 bonds over 3000 steps
secondary_metrics: tracker size and candidate copies with v2.1

decision.kinetic_effect: paired target bond formation count increases in at least 4 of 5 seeds and median paired difference is strictly positive; separate for each arm
decision.replication: do not claim replication from this test, regardless of copy candidate counts

interpretation_limits: S3 is a nonbonding external catalyst, not self-replication
S0 count is invariant; catalysis by S0 does not itself imply production of catalysts or autocatalytic growth
same seeds are paired but RNG streams may diverge when catalyst changes the number of possible reactions
sampling bond events does not measure per-opportunity reaction probability; causal interpretation limited to effect of configured law
M6 source hashes frozen, original M6.2-E report remains immutable
future shuffled-spatial controls would require separate preregistration and explicit mapping
goals: test a controlled local catalytic law against baseline
measure pathway specificity without adding a replication rule
preserve reproducibility of all prior milestones
